authority: Only M06 planning documents and own board evidence; no code, decoder, archive library or dependency created.
intent: Make the confirmed hard-block versus explicitly accepted missing-external-dependency distinction executable as pure policy before archive/merge runtime is ready.

architecture.hexagonal: Future decoder/validator adapter -> HOST trusted report mapping -> WORK evaluate_import_preflight -> immutable decision. No new output port or actual archive parser in S1.
architecture.dependencies: M01 project/document identity and M04 revision binding are context; M05 material validity and future M06 decoder supply observations. None are mutated.
architecture.ownership: External package bytes and target document remain owned by original source/target boundary. A preflight report/decision is derived evidence, not a new document SSOT or authority to write.
architecture.mutation: None. No extraction, identity allocation, reference remapping, Undo entry or filesystem path access. HOST must bind verified source and target revisions before actual apply in later slices.
architecture.transaction: S1 returns a pure decision. Real verified-source capture, staged merge/rollback and single Undo are later separately approved transactions; Allowed is not a commit receipt.

public_boundary_proposed.function: evaluate_import_preflight(report: &ImportValidationReport, context: &ImportPreflightContext, choice: IncompleteImportChoice) -> Result<ImportPreflightDecision, ImportPreflightError>
public_boundary_proposed.ImportBlocker: kind: UnsupportedFormat | UnsupportedVersion | Integrity | MissingInternalPayload | UnsafePath | AmbiguousEntry; subject:String; reason:String
public_boundary_proposed.note: Nested blocker-kind enum and data DTOs only. HOST must create this report from actual verified bytes and validation, never from UI claims that a package is safe.

contracts: Validate nonempty bounded document/dependency/subject/reason strings and sha256 syntax. Same project scope is resolved by HOST before this boundary; report is not authorization.

All blocking format/version/integrity/internal-payload/path/ambiguity problems yield Blocked even if missing dependencies were explicitly accepted. No destructive action or execution exists in any outcome.
With no blockers, source digest and target document/revision must match context. Mismatch yields StaleSource/StaleTarget; never mix validated and newly reopened bytes.
With no blockers and matching context, requires_other_document_change returns CrossDocumentChangeRequired, preserving the one-target-document merge boundary.

With no blockers/cross-document change and no missing external dependency return AllowedComplete. With missing dependencies and NotConfirmed return NeedsDependencyConfirmation. Explicit acceptance returns AllowedIncomplete with exact pending IDs and dependent_capabilities_blocked=true.

Sort/deduplicate missing dependency IDs by byte order; blocker list sort by fixed kind order then subject/reason. Do not silently discard a blocking reason. Outputs are action values, not proof of full container validity, successful commit or authorization to execute.

file_envelope_proposed.scope: Only proposed module declaration + pure preflight data/function/tests. No actual merge mutation in this file/slice.
file_envelope_proposed.future_command: cargo test -p sgenaxis-work --test phase1_import_preflight --no-run --locked then same without --no-run
